meta.name: i-have-adhd
meta.description: Shape output for a reader with ADHD: lead with the next action, number multi-step work, restate state across turns, suppress tangents, give specific time estimates, make wins visible. Invoke with /i-have-adhd; stays on until "stop adhd mode".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为ADHD读者调整输出格式，突出下一步行动和关键信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的读者容易分心，需要清晰、结构化的信息呈现。
copy.tagline_en: Format output for ADHD readers, highlighting next actions and key info
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your readers get distracted easily and need clear, structured information.

howto.what: Claude 的输出会以可执行的动作开头，多步骤任务编号列出，每轮对话重申当前进度，给出具体时间估算，突出已完成成果，并抑制无关话题。
howto.when: 当你说出“/i-have-adhd”时触发，持续生效直到你说“stop adhd mode”。

say.text: 帮我写一个登录功能，列出步骤。
say.note: Claude 会以编号步骤给出具体操作。

say.text: 解释一下这个代码，但要简短。
say.note: Claude 会直接解释，没有开场白。

howto.what_en: Claude's output leads with a concrete next action, numbers multi-step tasks, restates progress across turns, gives specific time estimates, makes wins visible, and suppresses tangents.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "/i-have-adhd". Stays active until you say "stop adhd mode".

say_en.text: Help me write a login function, list the steps.
say_en.note: Claude will respond with numbered steps.

say_en.text: Explain this code, but keep it brief.
say_en.note: Claude will explain directly without preamble.
